title: RuneScape Dragonwilds Update v1.0.1.2 HOTFIX! Major Combat Fixes, Xbox Multiplayer & Patch Notes
author: NRS NEO
description:
A new hotfix has arrived in RuneScape: Dragonwilds, bringing a fresh round of fixes for combat, progression, multiplayer, quests, and server stability!

In this video, we’re covering all the important changes, including the Air Magic Staff combo damage fix, the Dragon Scimitar Jump Attack issue, Runecrafting value corrections, and improvements for Xbox Series X hosted worlds. We’ll also look at the controller inventory freeze, the player progression issue, Kuldra skip fixes, quest interface problems, and a crash affecting Linux based dedicated servers.

Plus, we’re taking a look back at the previous Eye on Ashenfall update and its additions, including new ranged special attacks, the Death From Above perk, increased inventory capacity, and character save recovery improvements.

If you’ve been exploring Ashenfall, playing with friends, or working on your character progression, there are several fixes worth knowing about in this update.

Topics covered:

- Air Magic Staff combo damage fix
- Dragon Scimitar Jump Attack fix
- Runecrafting values and equipment durability
- Xbox multiplayer hosting improvements
- Controller inventory management fix
- Player progression and quest UI fixes
- Kuldra raid skip fixes
- Linux dedicated server crash fix
- Previous Eye on Ashenfall update recap
